nodes.label: Game Config
nodes.desc: Normalizes user config into renderer type, scale mode, physics config and scene classes.

nodes.label: Phaser.Game
nodes.desc: Constructs every global manager, then waits on DOM + texture events before running.

nodes.label: Game.boot
nodes.desc: Creates the renderer, DOM container, adds the canvas and defers start until textures are ready.

nodes.label: CreateRenderer
nodes.desc: AUTO resolves to WebGL when Features.webGL is true, otherwise Canvas; throws if the requested context is missing.

nodes.label: Game.start
nodes.desc: Sets isRunning and calls loop.start with the bound step (or headlessStep when no renderer).

nodes.label: TimeStep
nodes.desc: RequestAnimationFrame wrapper with optional fps limiting; owns frame counters and raw delta.

nodes.label: TimeStep.step
nodes.desc: Clamps negative deltas, optionally smooths them, then invokes the Game callback.

nodes.label: Game.step
nodes.desc: Emits PRE_STEP/STEP, updates scenes, emits POST_STEP, then preRender, scene.render and postRender.

nodes.label: SceneManager
nodes.desc: Holds the scenes array, drains queued operations each frame, boots and starts scenes.

nodes.label: Scene
nodes.desc: Thin class whose constructor builds a Systems bundle; users override init/preload/create/update.

nodes.label: Scene Systems
nodes.desc: init() installs core + scene plugins; step() emits PRE_UPDATE/UPDATE; render() sorts and draws.

nodes.label: bootScene
nodes.desc: Calls scene.init, resets the loader and either runs preload or jumps straight to create.

nodes.label: SceneManager.create
nodes.desc: Runs scene.create, binds scene.update, then flips settings.status to RUNNING.

nodes.label: SceneManager.update
nodes.desc: Processes queue ops then steps active scenes in reverse order so newer scenes update first.

nodes.label: SceneManager.render
nodes.desc: Iterates scenes forward, rendering only visible scenes between LOADING and SLEEPING status.

nodes.label: Systems.step
nodes.desc: PRE_UPDATE, UPDATE, then the user sceneUpdate hook, then POST_UPDATE.

nodes.label: Systems.render
nodes.desc: depthSorts the display list and hands it to the CameraManager for each camera.

nodes.label: DisplayList
nodes.desc: Structs.List of Game Objects; create/destroy callbacks keep it in sync with the scene.

nodes.label: depthSort
nodes.desc: Stable sort by depth so higher-depth objects paint on top each frame.

nodes.label: UpdateList
nodes.desc: Hooks SceneEvents.PRE_UPDATE to call preUpdate on every registered GameObject.

nodes.label: Transform component
nodes.desc: x/y/rotation/scale mixed into GameObjects; matrices are rebuilt on demand, not cached per frame.

nodes.label: applyITRS matrix
nodes.desc: applyITRS composes translate/rotate/scale into a TransformMatrix used by both renderers.

nodes.label: WebGLRenderer
nodes.desc: Batching GPU renderer: preRender, per-camera render via render nodes, postRender flush.

nodes.label: CameraManager
nodes.desc: Filters children per camera (culling, scroll, zoom) and invokes the renderer for each camera.

nodes.label: CanvasRenderer
nodes.desc: Immediate-mode 2D context renderer used when WebGL is unavailable or forced off.

nodes.label: ArcadePhysics
nodes.desc: Scene plugin that wires World.update to SceneEvents.UPDATE and World.postUpdate to POST_UPDATE.

nodes.label: World
nodes.desc: Owns body sets, a fixed-step accumulator, the RTree and the collider list.

nodes.label: World.step
nodes.desc: Updates every enabled body, reloads the collision tree, then runs active collider pairs.

nodes.label: Body
nodes.desc: AABB attached to a GameObject: velocity, drag, bounce, world bounds and blocking flags.

nodes.label: Body.preUpdate
nodes.desc: Syncs the body to its GameObject transform, then integrates position and checks separation.

nodes.label: InputManager
nodes.desc: Boots on GameEvents.BOOT, captures DOM events, tracks Pointer objects, emits manager events.

nodes.label: Per-scene InputPlugin
nodes.desc: Scene-level plugin that hit-tests display objects and emits pointerover, down, drag events.
